data.text: Low-income · price-hunter · A-loyal: “5% hike? I'm switching to B today.”
No price or marketing change, so shoppers see nothing new: counted as neutral.
“Raise price 5% now”: −$40.6k on average · bad case −$46.3k
“Stock up 4 weeks now”: +$948 on average · bad case +$618

Raising price alone loses customers heavily (rival is $0.50 cheaper). Stocking 4 weeks helps but exceeds $4k cash limit ($15.8k tied up). Need plans within cash: ~1 extra week of stock ($4k) combined with modest price rise or marketing to retain customers.

data.headline: Stock 1 week, raise price 2% in week 2
data.why: The plan covers a 28-38% egg-cost jump shown in the news while keeping one week of stock on hand. Simulated cash flow stays under the $4,000 limit and pays back the extra outlay by week 2.
data.watch_out: If bird flu spreads further, egg costs could climb past the 38% rise already reported, squeezing margin before the price increase takes full effect.
data.recheck_when: Next USDA egg-price report or supplier notice of further avian-flu outbreaks
data.cost_line: Eggs +38% × 24% of your cost is eggs = your cost +9% (+$0.40 a breakfast plate)

what_happened.text: Waffle House added a temporary 50-cent surcharge per egg to all menus.
Denny's said some restaurants would temporarily add a surcharge to every meal that includes eggs.
The BLS average for a dozen grade A large eggs reached a record $6.23.
Egg prices fell for the first time in months, to $5.12 in April, though they stayed near record highs.
Waffle House dropped its 50-cent egg surcharge as prices stabilised. The BLS average had fallen to $3.78 in June.

caveats: The series is the BLS retail price of eggs. A diner buys wholesale, which swung harder than retail in this episode, so the real swing was bigger than the one scored here. We did not swap in a wholesale source we could not cite.

Eggs are set at 24% of a plate's food cost: about 3 eggs a plate at the BLS price of $4.15 a dozen in December 2024 is $1.04 of $4.40. We found no published share for diners (a Spokane diner manager called eggs the restaurant's biggest expense), so the 3 eggs a plate is the made-up owner's figure.
Each monthly value is treated as the month's mid-point, with straight lines between them. BLS did not publish October 2025, which is outside this case's window.

The model has seen this period. Nemotron Ultra's model card gives a pre-training cutoff of September 2025 and a post-training cutoff of May 2026, so a date in the prompt cannot make it forget. The run only gives it news from before the date, and the leak check looks for hindsight in what it wrote.

“Best plan in hindsight” is the best of about 230 plans on a fixed grid (price, start, end, extra stock), run on the real path. Shoppers react to a sweep plan like they did to the nearest price plan the analysis tested; with none tested, they are neutral.
News pages are read as they are today. Any article that names a date after the as-of date is dropped, but a page edited later could still carry hindsight.
